title: Work kernel Type
description: One version of a Type, as written in YAML (types/*.yaml). Written by hand (Ventoux V2c) and checked in tests against what typedef accepts: it is never stricter. It covers keys and shapes, the closed lists of categories and field types, and that id and version are required; everything else (names that resolve, expressions that compile, the Types together) is typedef's and ValidateTypes's. For now it is as lenient as typedef: a text value may be any scalar, and most values may be null (docs/journal.md, Later).

id.description: The Type's ID: lower case, digits and _.

version.description: The version, 1 or more. A registered version never changes: publish the next one.

fields.description: The fields Items of this Type hold.

states.description: The states, each with a category.

transitions.description: The moves between states, and who may make them.

hooks.description: Calls to actions of the catalog: enrich, check and action hooks.

links.description: Link types from Items of this Type to other Items.

incoming.description: Names for links other Types declare to this one.

reactions.description: What happens to linked or contained Items when an Item of this Type moves.

accepts_reactions.description: Consent: which reactions of other Types (<type>:<reaction>) may write, move or create Items of this Type.

readable_by_reactions.description: Fields reactions of other Types may read.

offers.description: What this Type offers the hooks of Items created inside it: offer name -> field.

own.description: What a customer sees of their own Items.

shared.description: What a customer sees of Items shared with them.

placement_writable_by.description: Who may place Items of this Type in a container: role:<name> entries.

text.description: A text value. typedef reads any scalar as text for now.

writableBy.description: kernel (only hooks and the kernel write it), or a list of role:<name>.

accepted.description: A consent: a list of fields the reaction may write, or a map of fields, moves, creates and sets.

moves.description: States the reaction may move Items into.

creates.description: Fields a create reaction may set.

sets.description: Fields a set reaction may write.

multiple.description: The field holds a set of values.

max.description: A multiple field's most values (0: no limit).

unique_among_siblings.description: Fields whose values are unique among the Items of one container.

category.description: What the state means to every Type.

frozen.description: Fields no write may change in this state.

acting.description: Timers that act without leaving the state.

timer.description: Leave the state for another after a while.

atTimer.description: Leave the state for another at a datetime field's instant.

actingTimer.description: A timer that runs a hook or sets fields while the Item stays in its state.

transition.description: A move from one state to another.

guard.description: A CEL expression that must be true.

allowed.description: Who may make the move (empty: anyone who sees the Item).

except.description: Who may not, even if allowed.

escape.description: May leave a state while a hold is open.

hook.description: A call to an action of the catalog (<connector>.<operation>[@<major>]).

fallback.description: Values an enrich hook writes when its action fails.

inverse.description: The link's name seen from its target.

targets.description: The Types a link may point to (* for any).

max.description: one or many targets per source.

inverse_max.description: one or many sources per target.

linkResolve.description: How the kernel finds a link's target on entering a state.

incoming.description: A name, on this Type, for a link another Type declares to it.

reaction.description: A reaction: held, after, move, create or set.

children.description: The contained Items a reaction moves.

invariant.description: A rule every write must keep.

rule.description: A CEL expression that must be true.
